channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Storm Lala Strengthens to Hurricane While Closing In on Hawaii
item.description: Pacific storm Lala strengthened into a hurricane as it edged closer to Hawaii’s Big Island, where it will make possible landfall on Saturday, the US National Hurricane Center said.

item.title: Russia’s icy shipping route gamble gets India-China boost: Can NSR really challenge Hormuz?
item.description: Sea Legend launches the first regular container service along the Northern Sea Route, connecting China and Britain in about 20 days.&nbsp;

item.title: MP High Court stays FSSAI's ban on whisky, Khargone firm rum; 11 TASMAC brands cleared
item.description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court stayed an FSSAI ban on pre-packaged whisky and rum, while Tamil Nadu lifted its three-day-old restriction on the sale of 11 liquor brands through TASMAC outlets.

item.title: ‘Enough of Gandhian methods’: Jharkhand students give Hemant Soren govt Aug 18 deadline, threaten CM residence siege
item.description: Student leader Ravindra Paswan said the movement would enter a more aggressive phase if Jharkhand government failed to respond to the demands. Invoking revolutionary figure Bhagat Singh, he said protesters were no longer willing to rely solely on peaceful demonstrations.

item.title: Is China gaining an opening as Trump’s Iran war pulls US carrier George Washington from Pacific? What to know
item.description: President Donald Trump’s war with Iran is stretching the US Navy’s aircraft carrier fleet, with the USS George Washington leaving the Pacific for the West Asia and temporarily reducing America’s carrier presence

item.title: US to change key immigration forms for status extension from September 15: What Indians need to know
item.description: USCIS will introduce new editions of Forms I-539 and I-765 from September 15, with no grace period for old versions. Indian applicants seeking status extensions or work authorisation must use the correct editions.

item.title: ‘Biggest scam ever in the world’: Nithin Kamath asks startup founders not to brag about AI; social media reacts
item.description: Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath has dismissed AI claims in startup pitches as unoriginal, likening it to boasting about daily hygiene.&nbsp;

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's Maharashtra FDA suspends Parle Agro warehouse licence: Expired Frooti seized — what else was found?
item.description: Maharashtra FDA has reportedly suspended the license of a Velocity Express warehouse linked to Parle Agro after seizing expired beverages worth ₹99,970. The inspection revealed expired batches of Appy Fizz, Frooti, and Candy Juice during a night operation by eight officials.

item.title: Elon Musk plans $100 million push for Republicans in US midterms months after Trump feud: Report
item.description: Elon Musk is preparing to spend $100-$120 million through his super PAC to help Republicans in the US midterms, signalling a return to GOP politics after his bitter 2025 fallout with President Donald Trump.

item.title: Physics Wallah: Alakh Pandey offers ‘unconditional support’ to PM Modi for free online classes, seeks no profit
item.description: On 15 August, PM Modi announced free online coaching for competitive exams, supported by Alakh Pandey of Physics Wallah.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump administration gets court nod to end temporary protected status for thousands of Somali nationals
item.description: A US federal judge has lifted a stay blocking the Trump administration from ending Temporary Protected Status for Somali nationals. The move could expose migrants without another legal status to deportation.

item.title: Virginia State University Shooting: Campus lockdown lifted after multiple shots fired; several injured
item.description: Virginia State University shooting: A gun attack resulted in a lockdown and five individuals injured. Officers found the victims near Boisseau Street, with one in critical condition. The lockdown was reportedly lifted around 8 am, and investigations are ongoing.

item.title: 'How can any kid use this toilet?': Dipke launches 'School Thik Karo' campaign, inspects govt school in Maharashtra
item.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke launched the School Thik Karo campaign from Maharashtra's Hingoli, flagging poor facilities at a government school. He called for social audits to identify and address gaps in rural schools.

item.title: Indian H-1B visa holder risks immigration status after losing job at startup, seeks immediate employment on LinkedIn
item.description: AI Engineer Prayut Jain shared his struggles with his startup and is seeking immediate employment after losing his job weeks before a key equity milestone.&nbsp;

item.title: Indiana the Focus as Midwest Storms Flood Homes, Knock Out Power
item.description: More than 160,000 homes and businesses are still without electricity across Indiana after powerful storms brought record flooding, forcing residents to flee their homes, closing roads and snarling rail traffic.

item.title: 'Serious hygiene violations': Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA raids Bollywood Cafe, quick-commerce hubs
item.description: Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA raided Bollywood Cafe and inspected 86 quick-commerce hubs, flagging hygiene and food safety violations. Licences of 14 units were suspended and 60 improvement notices issued.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Another massive 6.9-magnitude quake jolts Indonesia hours after 7.7-magnitude tremor kills 38
item.description: Earthquake Today: Another &nbsp;6.9-magnitude quake shook Indonesia hours after 7.7-magnitude tremor killed 38 people. The second earthquake was centred near Pematangsiantar, around 126 kilometres (78 miles) southeast of Medan, the capital of island. The tremor occurred at a depth of 183 kilometres.

item.title: Indonesia earthquake today: Death toll rises to 38, victims ‘trapped’ in buildings after 7.7 magnitude quake—10 updates
item.description: Indonesia earthquake today: Tsunami waves of less than 1 metre (3 feet) were reported in several parts of the Southeast Asian nation following the early-morning tremor. The tsunami warning was withdrawn about three hours after the earthquake.

item.title: Watch: Meerut gig worker beaten up on camera over delay in delivery; social media reacts, ‘Put them behind bars’
item.description: A couple in Meerut is accused of assaulting and confining a delivery worker after a delivery dispute. A viral video shows the worker being dragged into their flat.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Expression of regret not a matter of prestige': BCI chief Manan Kumar Mishra apologises to law students amid NALSAR row
item.description: BCI chief Manan Kumar Mishra apologised to law students over remarks and letters linked to the NALSAR row, saying students' concerns matter and expressing regret if his words hurt their feelings.

item.title: Windfall tax on petrol exports cut to 0 after early August hike; diesel duty down ₹1.5/litre, ATF by ₹2.5/litre
item.description: The Centre has slashed windfall gains tax on petrol, diesel and ATF exports starting today, weeks after hiking rates amid rising tensions due to the war in West Asia. Here's how much the prices change…&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Nupur Prasad? IPS officer who headed Sushant Singh Rajput death probe awarded President's Medal
item.description: IPS officer Nupur Prasad, known for her role in the CBI investigation of Sushant Singh Rajput’s death, has been awarded the President's Medal for Meritorious Service. The MSM is conferred for valuable service distinguished by resourcefulness and dedication to duty.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge skip Red Fort I-Day event for second year in a row, BJP calls it 'childish'
item.description: Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge skipped the Red Fort Independence Day celebrations for the second year in a row. Sources cited protocol and seating concerns, while the BJP criticised their absence.

item.title: What is the Fragile Five, a term that PM Modi used to highlight India's growth in the last 12 years in his I-Day speech?
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, in his 13th consecutive Independence Day address, highlighted India's economic transformation from the 'Fragile Five' to a leading major economy.

item.title: Oil heist in Rajasthan, syndicate 'exposed': How eight accused stole 20 tonnes of crude from pipeline
item.description: During the investigation, an accused exposed the syndicate, leading to the arrest of seven others from Tapra village in Balotra district of Rajasthan. Here's what we know so far.

item.title: 'Armed Naxals may be eliminated, but Dimagi Naxals still lurking:' PM Modi launches scathing attack; Congress hits back
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday slammed ‘Dimagi Naxals’ during his 13th consecutive Independence Day address, calling on people to remain cautious of them. He said such elements must be identified and isolated, while urging efforts to bring youth into the mainstream.

item.title: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke launches 'School Thik Karo' campaign, conducts first audit: ‘No matter which party ruled…’
item.description: Before leaving for his native village of Santuk Pimpri in Hingoli district of Maharashtra, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) convenor Abhijeet Dipke criticised political parties for not doing enough to improve the infrastructure and standard of government schools.

item.title: Rain fury: Five Army personnel missing in Arunachal Pradesh after flash flood, four killed following massive landslide
item.description: At least five Army personnel were reported missing in Arunachal Pradesh's Dibang Valley district after heavy rainfall triggered a flash flood, while four others were killed after a massive landslide in Upper Subansiri district, officials said

item.title: PM Modi asks youth to help families with Census 2027, ensure error-free details: ‘Just an hour or two of your time’
item.description: Independence Day 2027: Appealing to the youth of the nation, Prime Minister Narendra Modi explained why recording accurate data as part of this census is significant.

item.title: Modi puts manufacturing, youth at heart of India’s 2047 growth push, unveils seven-pronged strategy
item.description: PM Modi's address marked a shift in the government’s Viksit Bharat narrative from the delivery of basic infrastructure and welfare outcomes of the past decade to a new goal centred on global competitiveness, self-reliance and structural reforms.

item.title: AI training, free coaching, Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan and more: PM Modi announces new initiatives for youth from Red Fort
item.description: PM Modi in his 80th Independence Day speech talked about a ‘Viksit Bharat’, linking it with the youth of India. Check initiative launched by the PM today.

item.title: 80th Independence Day: PM Modi delivers shortest Red Fort speech in 4 years - When was his longest?
item.description: On India's 79th Independence Day last year, Prime Minister Narendra Modi on delivered a 103-minute Independence Day speech from the ramparts of the Red Fort, the longest by any prime minister in India's history.

item.title: PM Modi announces civil defence network in Independence Day speech, flags threats within borders: Here's what he said
item.description: Announcing the civil defence initiative on Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, “Today, from the ramparts of the Red Fort, I announce that in the coming days, we will establish a modern and vibrant network of Civil Defense.”

item.title: Saptadhara to civil defence and vision for the Gen-Z: Key takeaways from PM Modi's Independence Day speech from Red Fort
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday greeted the nation on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day, marking his 13th consecutive Independence Day address from the Red Fort. From semiconductors and energy reforms to national security and self-reliance, here are the key takeaways from his speech

item.title: CJP Instagram account back after founder Abhijeet Dipke claims it was taken down; here's what happened
item.description: The Instagram account of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) was briefly removed from the platform, alleged founder Abhijeet Dipke. ‘Bloody cowards’ he said on X.
